title: Ad creative signaling Event Timeline record
description: One record on an MSF Event Timeline track whose eventType is urn:svta:advertising-wg:ad-creative-signaling. Encodes the record requirements of draft-riedl-moq-ad-creative-signaling Section 4: exactly one index reference field, typed as MSF-01 Section 8.1 requires, and a data member holding exactly one SVTA 2053-1 Version 2 carriage envelope, with the envelope-level rules of SVTA 2053-1 Section 5.2.2.1 (Table 15). The payload objects (Pod, Slot, TrackingEvent, Verification) are governed by SVTA 2053-1 and are not checked here. Note the DASH and HLS bindings also accept bare Version 1 payload objects; this binding does not.

m.description: Media PTS index (MSF-01 Section 8.1): a JSON Number of milliseconds on the timeline of the depends media track. RECOMMENDED for records describing creatives spliced into the media timeline.

t.description: Wallclock index (MSF-01 Section 8.1): a JSON Number of milliseconds since the Unix epoch, not a date string. For placement opportunities defined in wallclock terms where no media time is available.

l.description: MOQT Location index (MSF-01 Section 8.1): [Group ID, Object ID]. For records bound to a delivery position rather than a media time.

payload.description: At least one payload object, of the kind named by type.

features.description: Boolean feature flags. SVTA 2053-1 defines only remoteFields; an interpreter that does not support a flag set to true SHOULD ignore the payload, so no other flag may be true.
